hero.title: Kado organizes your gift exchanges without the hassle.
hero.description: Create a draw in minutes, share unique participant links, and let Kado handle the assignment constraints. No required account, no ads, no tracking.
hero.audience: Built for exchanges among friends, family, or coworkers.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.description: The code is public. You can inspect it, use it, modify it, or host it yourself.

privacy.title: Privacy respected
privacy.description: No account is required to participate. Each person simply receives a personal link.

noMonetization.title: No intrusive monetization
noMonetization.description: No ads, no data resale, and no tracking cookies.

cta.organizerTitle: I want to organize a draw
cta.organizerDesc: Create an exchange, add participants, define exclusions if needed, then run the draw. Each person gets a unique link to share through whatever channel you prefer.
cta.participantDesc: You received a personal link from the organizer. Open it directly to access your participation. No account and no password required.
cta.participantHint: Didn't receive a link? Contact the person organizing the draw.

why.title: Why trust Kado?
why.description: A simple, transparent, and independent tool for running exchanges without unnecessary friction.

simple.title: Simple by design
simple.description: Kado does one thing well: organize gift exchanges without detours or unnecessary complexity.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.description: The project is open and its behavior is public. Nothing is hidden inside a black box.

independent.title: Independent
independent.description: Kado is maintained as a useful tool first, not as a product designed to extract attention.

support.title: Kado is free and will stay that way.
support.subtext: If the app is useful to you and you'd like to help cover hosting and development costs, you can give the project a small boost.
